notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting(8)': Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince (posted 'Agents of Black Sun / Xizor Rocks'), Coruscant, Coruscant: Imperial City, Prince Xizor, Imperial Arrest Order, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement, Mobilization Points, Prepared Defenses; these count toward the 60.
The description says the deck went undefeated at Nevada States (2001 Nevada State Championship).
Posted 'Grabber' is kept as written: it names no card. (The draft's Allegations Of Corruption is a Coruscant-set card, not yet printed in April 2001.)

Posted 'CCDB' dested Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay); 'DSDB' Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark); 'CoruscantDB' Coruscant: Docking Bay (Special Edition); 'SpaceportDB' Spaceport Docking Bay (Dark); Coruscant dested the Special Edition Dark printing.

Posted 'Fett with Blaster' dested Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; '4Lom with rifle' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'IG88 with gun' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'Jodo Cast' Jodo Kast; 'Zuckuss in ship' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Bossk in bus' Bossk In Hound's Tooth.
Disarmed, Stun Blaster and Vibro Ax dested the Dark pages.
The strategy (written after comments) says he would swap Bad Feeling Have I for Rendili and add I Have You Now; the list is kept as posted.
